version.description: Schema metadata version per ADR-0016. Const v1 = initial baseline. Future bumps require version-migration flow.

title: Spec Workflow Iteration (Current Sprint) State
description: Persistent view of the current iteration/sprint: which OpenSpec changes are proposed/in-worktree/completed/archived, their blocker relationships, and current task progress. Stored at .rddf/state/iteration.json.

version.description: Schema version. v5: added l2_violation_count_after and l2_violation_kind per-change fields. v6: added filled_at per-change field. v7: added cross_repo_dependencies per-change field for Hub-and-Spoke federation.

current_phase.description: Current roadmap phase (e.g. 'v2.1'). May be 'default' or 'unknown' in compat mode.

changes.description: One entry per OpenSpec change ever observed in the current iteration. Archived changes are kept (not deleted) for history.

name.description: OpenSpec change name (directory name under openspec/changes/).

phase.description: Roadmap phase this change belongs to. From roadmap-meta.yaml.

category.description: Roadmap category within the phase. From roadmap-meta.yaml.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Updated by propose/guide-ship/execute/archive hooks.

archive_path.description: Path to OpenSpec archived change directory.

note.description: Free-form annotation explaining a partial/exceptional archive state.

added_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the change was first added to iteration.

tasks_done.description: Number of completed tasks in tasks.md.

blocker.description: Name of the change that hard-blocks this one.

last_deps_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last deps run.

archived_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when status transitioned to archived.

archive_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the archive action.

parent_feature.description: Name of the parent feature/epic this change belongs to.

l2_violation_count_after.description: Project-wide L2 violation count AFTER this change was archived.

l2_violation_kind.description: Which L2 violation kind was counted.

filled_at.description: Timestamp when a skeleton change was filled.

cross_repo_dependencies.description: List of cross-repo dependencies in 'org/repo#change' format. v7 (add-cross-repo-deps-orchestration).

feature_view.description: Derived view written by skills/feature.md. Optional.
